title: "GitHub Actions with Nix"

# GitHub Actions with Nix

CI workflows often suffer from slow tool installations and flaky runner environments. The boring default is: **use `cachix/install-nix-action` and `cachix/cachix-action` in GitHub Actions to build and test directly inside hermetic Nix sandboxes**.

## Mental model

Traditional GitHub Actions workflows install tools using multiple action plugins (`actions/setup-go`, `actions/setup-python`, `actions/setup-node`).

With Nix:
- A single action installs Nix on the runner.
- The workflow runs `nix build` or `nix flake check`.
- Builds and test outputs are cached to your binary cache, turning 15-minute CI pipelines into 30-second cache downloads.

## Worked examples

Save as `ci.yml`:

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v27
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-24.11
      - uses: cachix/cachix-action@v15
        with:
          name: desk-cache
          authToken: ${{ secrets.CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN }}
      - name: Check flake and build
        run: nix flake check
```

## The boring rule

- Standardize CI on Nix to match local developer environments byte-for-byte.
- Cache build outputs automatically in CI.
